description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling CRUD operations on LLM cost records, including tenant enforcement, authorization, and request diagnostics.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLM cost records with tenant scoping and filtering.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an LLM cost record by ID.
